verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is an incorporation SaaS service. A SaaS product could plausibly expose an API with scoped credentials for agents, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any Atlas API keys, scoped or restricted credentials, or agent-specific access controls. The llms.txt and docs-md probes only show documentation is machine-readable, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so neither establishes credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
